verdict.rationale: Porkbun docs confirm an API to check 'domain availability and pricing across hundreds of TLDs' (porkbun-docs-35), and community commentary contrasts Porkbun favorably against registrars with hidden renewal spikes (porkbun-comm-3, porkbun-comm-5), suggesting transparent pricing culture, but no evidence explicitly shows a published price list separating registration, renewal, and transfer prices per TLD. Missing for 10: an explicit published pricing table/page showing per-TLD registration vs renewal vs transfer prices, and independent verification that no teaser first-year pricing exists.
